messages.content: What is the permissible thesis plagiarism similarity index?

Based on official university records, here is the relevant policy regarding **What is the permissible thesis plagiarism similarity index**:

### 📘 Research Ethics, Plagiarism & IP Policy (Page 1)

- ACADEMIC INTEGRITY AND PLAGIARISM BYLAWS SECTION 1: SIMILARITY THRESHOLDS & THESIS VERIFICATION 1.1 Permissible Similarity Index: All undergraduate capstone theses, master's dissertations, and doctoral research must be screened through the university Turnitin/Urkund portal. `[Research Ethics, Plagiarism & IP Policy | Page 1]`
- - Overall Similarity Index must not exceed 10% (excluding bibliography and generic quotes). `[Research Ethics, Plagiarism & IP Policy | Page 1]`
- - Individual source similarity must be less than 2%. `[Research Ethics, Plagiarism & IP Policy | Page 1]`

### 📘 Research Conduct & Academic Integrity 2026 (Page 1)

- Section 1: Plagiarism detection is mandatory for all undergraduate capstone theses. `[Research Conduct & Academic Integrity 2026 | Page 1]`
- Section 2: Similarity index must not exceed 10 percent. `[Research Conduct & Academic Integrity 2026 | Page 1]`

---
📌 *All statements above are directly grounded in the official University Regulations and verified against the registered source pages.*

citations.snippet: ACADEMIC INTEGRITY AND PLAGIARISM BYLAWS SECTION 1: SIMILARITY THRESHOLDS & THESIS VERIFICATION 1.1 Permissible Similarity Index: All undergraduate capstone theses, master's dissertations, and doctoral research must be screened through the university Turnitin/Urkund portal. - Overall Similarity Index must not exceed 10% (excluding bibliography and generic quotes). - Individual source similarity must be less than 2%. 1.2 Penalties for Plagiarism: - Level 1 (Similarity 10% - 40%): Student must revise and resubmit the thesis within 6 months. - Level 2 (Similarity 40% - 60%): Resubmission debarred for 1 full academic year. - Level 3 (Similarity > 60%): Permanent cancellation of research registration and degree denial.

University Code of Academic Integrity and Research Conduct 2026. Section 1: Plagiarism detection is mandatory for all undergraduate capstone theses. Section 2: Similarity index must not exceed 10 percent.

messages.content: What is the minimum attendance required for examinations and medical condonation limit?

Based on official university records, here is the relevant policy regarding **What is the minimum attendance required for examinations and medical condonation limit**:

### 📘 Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules (Page 1, Page 2)

- SECTION 2: CONDONATION AND SHORTAGE CONSEQUENCES 2.1 Condonation of Attendance Shortage (Medical & Sports): The Dean of Academic Affairs may condone attendance shortage up to 10% (i.e., between 65% and 74.9% attendance) strictly on grounds of: - Prolonged hospitalization or certified illness (Official medical certificate must be submitted within 3 working days of resuming classes). `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 2]`
- No condonation is permitted for students with attendance below 65% under any circumstances. `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 2]`
- 2.2 Detention Due to Shortage (Grade SA): Students who fail to secure 75% attendance (or 65% with approved condonation) will be awarded the 'SA' (Shortage of Attendance) grade `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 2]`
- OFFICIAL UNIVERSITY ATTENDANCE POLICY SECTION 1: MANDATORY ATTENDANCE REQUIREMENTS 1.1 Aggregate Attendance Threshold: Every regular student is mandated to maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in aggregate across all registered courses (theory and practicals) in every academic semester. `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 1]`
- Attendance is calculated from the official semester start date until the last instructional working day. `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 1]`
- 1.2 Laboratory & Practical Attendance: Laboratory courses require a strict 80% physical attendance. `[Student Attendance Policy & Leave Rules | Page 1]`

### 📘 college-rules (Page 5)

- Attendance & Leave of Absence 3.1 The college works from 9.30 a.m. `[college-rules | Page 5]`
- For the purpose of attendance, all working days will be considered as full working days irrespective of the number of hours. `[college-rules | Page 5]`
- Absence during one hour either in the forenoon or the afternoon session will be considered half a day of absence. `[college-rules | Page 5]`

### 📘 Examination Regulations & Assessment Rules (Page 1)

- OFFICIAL UNIVERSITY EXAMINATION MANUAL SECTION 1: ASSESSMENT WEIGHTAGE AND ELIGIBILITY 1.1 Evaluation Structure: The assessment in each theory course comprises: - Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE): 40% weightage (Mid-term tests: 25%, Quizzes/Assignments: 10%, Class Participation: 5%). `[Examination Regulations & Assessment Rules | Page 1]`
- - Semester End Examination (SEE): 60% weightage. `[Examination Regulations & Assessment Rules | Page 1]`
- A candidate must secure at least 40% in SEE and 40% in overall aggregate (CIE + SEE) to pass the course. `[Examination Regulations & Assessment Rules | Page 1]`
